grh_e959de7598daef3ccce6.title: The Runaway
paragraphs: College basketball player Adam reaches Rivers End frightened and on the run. He finally admits to Dr. Christian that he helped fix games at Midwestern University and fled because he believes the gambling syndicate behind the scheme has sent two gangsters after him. From his hotel room he points out one man watching the elevator and another sitting across the street, convinced they are waiting to follow him onto a lonely road and kill him. Dr. Christian tells Adam that escape will only deepen his trouble and persuades him to return to school, confess the basketball fix and accept the consequences. To get him past the men he fears, the doctor smuggles him from the hotel on a covered ambulance stretcher and puts him aboard the train. Only afterward does Dr. Christian reveal the irony: the supposed gangsters are ordinary Rivers End fixtures, one a longtime hotel-lobby reader and the other a harmless man who spends his days reading on a park bench. Adams guilty conscience turned strangers into pursuers, but the fear still pushed him toward the honest decision he needed to make.

This [[show|dr-christian|Dr. Christian]] broadcast aired on June 6, 1951. It is listed as episode 653 in the archive. [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Jean Hersholt, Rosemary De Camp, Herb Ellis, Jeffrey Silver, and Stanley Farrar. Other credited names include Ronald J. Donlevy as writer and Art Gilmore as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 30 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.514e831176595875|Vaseline Hair Tonic]] and [[org|org.ec0e2015375f597c|Vaseline Petroleum Jelly]].

grh_e94d6a3d8270edbb2a39.title: The Painted Smile
paragraphs: On holiday in Sicily, Harry reunites with circus clown Antonio Vega, an old friend who secretly finances his daughter's education through emerald smuggling. Vega shows Harry the fortune he has saved for the girl and asks him to protect it if anything happens. His daughter unexpectedly arrives and learns the truth about her father while local public-safety officials close in on the smuggling operation. At the circus, Vega's jealous lover Lola deliberately switches cages during his animal act, sending a genuinely vicious cat at him instead of the trained one. Harry exposes the switch and Lola's motive, revealing that the danger was an attempted murder born from jealousy rather than an accident.

paragraphs: In the Bavarian village of Edendorf, shy schoolteacher Carl loves Sieglinde while helping her father, the village schoolmaster, bring a new song to life. grh_e916c9bbd691172d39a3.title: On Wings Of Song
paragraphs: Famous opera star Angela D'Nello returns to Rivers End, prompting Dr. Christian to remember the hometown moments that shaped her career. As a young singer she won a local music scholarship, and later, frozen by stage fright on an important opening night, Dr. Christian helped her find her voice by reminding her to sing as if she were back among the friends who first believed in her.
